args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with elevated error rate (0.18) since deploy. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. Rollback verified as rolled out.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with health checks failing and an elevated error rate (0.18).
2. **Identified target**: From the deployment history, v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.3.1 was unhealthy; v2.3.1-rc was only staging).
3. **Rolled back**: Executed rollback of `checkout-api` to v2.3.0 in all production regions — verified as rolled out.
4. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident INC-0001 for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback; on-call has been paged.
